Thank you for using [Project Name]! We are here to help. Please review the resources below to find the answers you need.

## 1. Search Existing Resources
Before reaching out, please check if your question has already been answered:
* Read through our [Documentation](#) (link to your docs)
* Search through our [Closed Issues](https://github.com) for similar problems.

## 2. Reporting a Bug
If you have found a bug, please help us help you by providing the following details:
* **Environment:** OS, browser, and version of [Project Name] you are using.
* **Steps to Reproduce:** Exact steps to make the issue occur.
* **Expected vs. Actual Behavior:** What you wanted to happen, versus what actually happened.
* **Logs/Screenshots:** Include relevant error messages or console logs.

Submit your bug report using our [Issue Tracker](https://github.com).

## 3. Getting Help and Asking Questions
For "how-to" questions, troubleshooting, or general concepts you don't understand:
* Post a thread in our [GitHub Discussions](#) (link to your discussions if enabled).
* Reach out to our community on [Discord/Slack](#) (link to chat).

## 4. Security Vulnerabilities
Please **do not** report security issues via public GitHub Issues. Instead, email us directly at [security@yourdomain.com](#) for private handling.
